name: Peru

tourists: Over 4.4M international visitors; famous for Inca Trail trek, Lake Titicaca floating reed islands, and Colca Canyon condors.
must_know: Greeting with a light kiss on the right cheek is standard; Peruvians take immense pride in Lima being South America's gastronomic hub.
fun_fact: Peru is the birthplace of the potato, cultivating more than 4,000 native varieties ranging in purple, yellow, and red hues.
